opti-1: Deep in a Florida swamp, tall cypress trees reach for the sky.
opti-2: Something white hangs in the shade. A ghost orchid!
opti-3: When an orchid's seed pod splits open, out pour its seeds.
opti-4: Thousands of them. Each one is as tiny as a speck of dust.
opti-5: A seed? As tiny as dust?
opti-6: Zoom in a hundred times. Each seed is a thin, see-through bag.
opti-7: Fern spores are tiny, too. They drift on the air like dust.
opti-8: So how can you tell a tiny seed from a spore?
21-02-welcome: Our film starts in a Florida swamp, with seeds as tiny as dust. First, look closely at a peanut.
21-02-lesson: Today you're the plant sorter. Watch a spore become a fern, test a seed and a spore, then dig for clues.
21-02-assign: Time to sort. Read each clue, then show how seeds and spores are alike and different.
21-02-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
how-21-02-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the peanuts, then tap three things you notice.
how-21-02-compare: Put the sieve by one tray and the cup of water by the other: drag them, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Test it. Then swap them and press it again.
how-21-02-det: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict seed or spore, and watch its home appear.
how-21-02-partc: Draw a seed and a spore cluster side by side. Label a part of the seed, and the spores.
